faq.q: Does Trackeys work with our existing GPS hardware?
faq.a: Yes. Certified connectors for Samsara, Geotab, Motive and most major telematics providers. For proprietary or niche devices, a standardized ingest API handles the rest.

A composite score weighs speeding (vs. posted limits), harsh braking, acceleration, cornering, idling and seatbelt compliance. Weights are configurable per fleet profile and the engine learns from your historical data.

faq.q: Can drivers see their own scorecards?
faq.a: Yes. Drivers get a mobile scorecard with their own trends, coaching tips and peer comparisons. Gamification is optional — with leaderboards that reward safety and efficiency.

faq.q: Does it handle mixed fleets (trucks, vans, cars, bikes)?
faq.a: Yes. Vehicle profiles model weight, volume, fuel type, emissions and job fit. The routing and allocation engine respects constraints for every vehicle class.
